ref: ADR-0003: a pattern that does not translate to an XPath picture is a design-time error; ADR-0026 pattern params (#74 amendment): invalid-parameter-value at the box, naming the element (the digit 5)
note: The pattern 5#. A digit other than 0 as text: DecimalFormat writes 5 as literal text before the number, and a picture reads it as a digit. Compiling refuses it at N1.
